info.title: Nirnoy Diagnostics API
info.description:
Diagnostic laboratory platform API.

**Envelope.** Successful responses: `{"success": true, "data": ..., "meta": {...}}`.
Errors: `{"success": false, "error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}`.

**Auth.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Web clients refresh through the
HttpOnly `nirnoy_rt` cookie at `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`.

**Authorisation.** Each endpoint states its required permission. Permissions are enforced
server-side and may be scoped (branch, lab, corporate, partner).

get.description: PostgreSQL and Redis are critical; storage is informational.

post.summary: Send a one-time code by SMS
post.description: Public. Responds identically whether or not the number is registered. Rate-limited per phone and per IP.

post.summary: Sign in (or register) a patient with an SMS code
post.description: Public. Creates a patient account on first sign-in. Staff accounts are rejected with `STAFF_PASSWORD_LOGIN_REQUIRED`.

post.summary: Sign in with phone/email and password
post.description: Public. Staff accounts receive a two-factor challenge instead of tokens; complete it with `POST /auth/2fa/verify`.

post.summary: Complete staff sign-in with the SMS code
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
post.description: Web: reads the HttpOnly cookie. Mobile: send `refresh_token` in the body. Replaying a rotated token revokes the session (`TOKEN_REUSED`).

post.summary: End the session identified by the refresh cookie (access token expired)
End every session of the current user
Reset the password with an SMS code (signs out all sessions)
Change or set the password (signs out other sessions)
